DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A

The significantly low Factor VIII level (15%) combined with your history of post-extraction bleeding and easy bruising confirms Hemophilia A. This genetic disorder impairs your blood's ability to clot properly, leading to the symptoms you described.
